planting.note: Set rooted cuttings or nursery starts out around the last frost in lean, sharply drained soil in full sun; this cultivar does not come true from seed and is propagated vegetatively from cuttings or division.

directions: English Broadleaf is a selection of common thyme with notably wider, larger, darker-green leaves than standard French or common thyme, giving a milder, less pungent, slightly sweeter flavor than narrow-leaved types. The broader foliage also makes it faster to harvest and easier to strip from the stem for kitchen use. It is somewhat less cold-hardy and less drought-tolerant than French thyme, preferring slightly richer soil and more consistent moisture, and it tends toward a more sprawling, less compact habit that benefits from a light shearing after flowering to keep it from opening up in the center. Popular as a robust, easy-care culinary thyme for cooks who want ample leaf volume without the intensity of narrow-leaved cultivars.
